source.mechanics_reference: Superior Slayer-style optional enhanced task monster; pin a primary reference before implementation
source.attribution: Design proposal only; no upstream code or binary assets included
source.permission_review: required before importing any code or asset

target.allocation_policy: append-only audited namespace; never infer free IDs from max-name-only scans

dependencies.textures: transitive dependencies of the reused models; catalogue before build
dependencies.sounds_music: reuse baseline NPC sounds if compatible; no new audio

behaviour.eligibility: optional feature enabled; owner has matching task; eligible base NPC killed normally
behaviour.spawn_roll: proposed local tuning 1/200, not a claim of canonical OSRS balance
behaviour.spawn_limit: one pending/active enhanced spawn per eligible player; no recursive rolls
behaviour.placement: server chooses a reachable collision-valid tile; skip spawn if none exists
behaviour.appearance: reuse 634 model and animation; subtle scale/recolour only after visual checks
behaviour.combat: native pre-EoC rules; inspect full NPC combat/bas/sound dependencies before cloning
behaviour.drops: existing 634 low-value loot only for first proof; no OSRS unique items
behaviour.task_credit: proposed exactly one eligible task credit on kill; no second credit on spawn
solo_deviations: no unlock shop or new currency in the first proof
behaviour.persistence: no new persistent item IDs initially; default disabled is not a save migration
behaviour.multiplayer_policy: per-player eligibility and spawn ownership; retain other players' normal actions

verification.expected_changed_entries: one audited NPC definition only if a distinct native ID is required; decide after baseline audit
verification.original_entries_unchanged: require decoded entry hashes and cache integrity, not sector byte equality
verification.rollback: disable new spawns; retain registry tombstones and compatibility definitions for affected saves; restore baseline only with compatible profile copy
